verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch is MIT-licensed open source and supports self-hosting with 'full data ownership' plus import of collections/environments/cURL, which supports data portability and openness, but the evidence pack never documents an explicit export feature (e.g., exporting collections/environments to JSON/OpenAPI) that would let a user cleanly take data out. Missing for 10: documented export functionality, supported export formats, and independent confirmation that exported data is usable outside Hoppscotch.
